content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with P.G. Degree/DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institution; Valid registration from Delhi Medical Council or must have DMC acknowledgment slip on or before the date of interview Age limit: 45 years for UR, 48 years for OBC (Delhi) (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: UR 45, OBC (Delhi) 48 Other conditions: OBC candidates must submit their Caste Certificate along with Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate issued after 31.03.2026 by Govt. of NCT of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GNEC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed 03 years of Senior Residency in any recognized Institution/Hospital

content_sections.heading: GNEC Senior Resident (Anaesthesia) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment shall be purely on adhoc and emergent basis for a period of 44 days or till regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. Maximum tenure of Senior Residency shall be 03 years.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application Form 10th Marksheet/Certificate 12th Marksheet/Certificate MBBS Degree FMGE, if applicable PG Degree/Diploma DMC registration/acknowledgment slip Caste Certificate, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GNEC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report to the Low Vision Clinic for enrollment and verification of documents on 03.11.2026 between 09.30 AM to 11.30 AM. Bring filled application form in Annexure-I along with original and one set of self-attested photocopies of required documents and 2 passport size photographs.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No candidate shall be allowed to enter after 11.30 AM on the day of interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for GNEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GNEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GNEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for UR, 48 years for OBC (Delhi) (as on date of interview). Relaxation: UR 45, OBC (Delhi) 48.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level-11, Cell No. 1 @ Rs. 67,700 of the Pay Matrix plus usual allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with P.G. Degree/DNB in the concerned specialty.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. OBC candidates must submit their Caste Certificate along with Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate issued after 31.03.2026 by Govt. of NCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed 03 years of Senior Residency in any recognized Institution/Hospital.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment shall be purely on adhoc and emergent basis for a period of 44 days or till regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. Maximum tenure of Senior Residency shall be 03 years.
